card.name: Words before praised qualities in history prose
card.fires_on: Small linking or degree words (of, by, his, great, very) inside old-style historical or biographical prose, just before a noun naming a quality, skill or deed, such as skill, zeal, frankness or execution.

modes.label: Degree words
modes.description: Adjectives like great or moderate sitting before a noun of quality or amount.

modes.description: Of, by or his that sit between a verb or noun and a described trait.

modes.label: Verb of showing
modes.description: A verb of showing or displaying that is followed by a quality such as zeal.
modes.example: The Crew<< manifested>> their Zeal in Support of the Honor
